approvers: Just me; developer client would need to agree if it is a separate line
reason: We don't buy this today and it would mean a new line and a new supplier, with no Maltese reference job. I buy from people I've worked with for years, and glazing damage is something we already absorb or fix at snagging.
objection: In July and August half the façade is in full sun, so when can you even apply it, and who is liable when it bakes on or leaves residue on the frames? €2,500 cover on a block of glazing is nothing.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape from the hardware store, have the crew be careful, and pay for the odd repair at handover.
would_change_my_mind: A finished Maltese block from a contractor I know, where the coating came off clean in summer and the damage saved was clearly more than the cost per m².
